notes.title: June 21 2023 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, Guilty Gear fans![/h1]

A new update is available for Guilty Gear XX Accent Core Plus R. This time, a few improvements have been implemented to enhance the offline experience a bit, and some bugfixes for online play.

Last month, the Guilty Gear franchise and its creators Arc System Works have celebrated their 25th and 35th anniversaries respectively.
ASW has opened a [url=https://www.arcsystemworks.jp/35th/en/]special anniversary website[/url], where you can read messages from their staff and [url=https://www.arcsystemworks.jp/35th/en/series/]vote for your favorite ASW game[/url]. You can vote once per day, so I encourage each ASW fan to visit the website daily!

Please find the complete list of improvements and fixes below.

[h2]Improvements for offline VS2P and TEAMVS2P[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new "BUTTON SETTINGS" icon is now available at the bottom of the character select screen. Press it to open a minified version of the "BUTTON SETTINGS" menu.
[*] In this new minified "BUTTON SETTINGS" menu, you will also find a new entry named "BUTTON CHECK". Select this entry to access the "BUTTON CHECK" screen, which will help you verify your settings.
[*] In battle, pausing now behaves and looks similar to pausing in Guilty Gear Xrd or Guilty Gear Strive: you need to hold the key for a brief amount of time instead of just pressing it once, with a small gauge indicator at the bottom of the screen. This prevents accidental pauses.
[/list]
[h2]New "AUDIO DEVICE" setting[/h2]
In "DISPLAY & AUDIO SETTINGS" menu, you will find a new "AUDIO DEVICE" setting. With this setting, you can easily force the game to use your favorite audio device, or tune the behaviour for the default device from Windows sound settings. This setting is saved to the [i]DisplaySettings.cfg[/i] file.

I recommend offline tournament organizers to select and save a favorite audio device for the tournament setup (for example, the TV's speakers). Doing so will prevent common tournament issues, such as an official console gamepad stealing the audio feed.

[h2]Bugfixes and adjustments for online modes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Spectator Mode has 3 new filters : Ranked Random, Ranked Best Rank, Ranked Best Winstreak. Watch high-level ranked battles in realtime!
[*] During an online battle, illegal characters are now instantly defeated at the beginning of the round.
[*] Fixed a possible leaderboard crash.
[*] Fixed a super rare bug that caused the big Quick Match lobby to have incorrect filters and settings.
[/list]
[h2]Other adjustments and bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] On most hybrid-GPU systems, such as gaming laptops with Nvidia Optimus or AMD's equivalent, the default setting is now the dedicated high-performance GPU.
[*] Optimized the gamepad detection to use less computing ressources.
[*] Fixed a bug in the DirectInput gamepad detection logic that prevented players from replugging the same DirectInput gamepad in a different USB port.
[*] Fixed keyboard players being able to unbind the confirm button.
[/list]

[i]Reminder: most game settings, such as button settings, are only saved when you're going through the "Saving..." screen. If you want to make sure your settings are saved, go back to the title screen before closing the game.[/i]

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Security patch (July 19 2022)
notes.notes:
We have released a patch for the Steam version "GUILTY GEAR XX ACCENT CORE PLUS R" to resolve a vulnerability in the game system. Both the main branch and the legacy branch have been updated.

Please update your game to the latest version.

notes.title: December 23 2021 Update Note
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- Fix: In Winner Stays player rooms, removed the AFK skip countdown text to fix a major crash which affected players using the Japanese language setting.
- Fix: In Free For All player rooms, fixed incorrect printing for the 'Other challenges pending' notice when the language is set to Japanese.

notes.title: May 22 2021 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Fixes and improvements:
* (Netplay) Fixed rare desync when Force Breaks such as Baiken's Baku are used.
* (Netplay) Fixed rare desync when players skip intro animations at a specific frame.
* (Netplay) Fixed blackbeat indicator displaying incorrect or duplicate number of hits.
* (Netplay) Fixed an issue which prevented GGPO from establishing connection in some rare cases.
* (Network Mode) Matchmaking menu is no longer cropped on ultrawide monitors.
* (Network Mode) Training mode submenus (Extra Menu etc) are now correctly closed when going back to player room.
* (Performance) XInput polling performance improved. This may fix inconsistent framerate for some players.
* (Stability) Game no longer crashes when viewing global Survival rankings.
* (Training Mode) Reversal Action now also activates on clash.
* (Training Mode) Reversal: Attack correctly activates if there's a one frame gap before next hit and Dummy has guard enabled.
* (Training Mode) Reversal: Memory now plays correctly even if the memory slot was recorded using Record Player function (instead of Record Enemy).
* (Training Mode) Reversal: Memory and State: Memory now work correctly for Dummy vs Dummy and Dummy vs CPU.

notes.title: Update for Player Match V2 Public Testing
notes.notes:
[h2]Changelog[/h2]
* Improved performance (FPS stability, less rollbacks) when playing in rooms with many players.

Restart your Steam client to make sure you receive the update.
[b]This update is for "publictest" beta only.[/b]
See the following announcement for more information on the ongoing public test: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/348550/view/3105772592523126191

[h2]How can I participate in the public test?[/h2]
Please follow this procedure to participate in this public test:
* Right click the game in your Steam library
* Click "Properties..."
* Go to "Betas" and select "publictest - GGPOupdatetest". Please note that the branch will be only visible when the public testing starts (Friday May 7th 2021 00:00). If testing has started and you still don’t see the branch, please restart Steam and try again.
* Close the properties menu
* The game should automatically update. After the update has ended, you’re set to go!

notes.title: March 27 2021 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
* In the previous update we had forced VSync Off in Network mode, we have reverted this change in this update.
* Allowed binding more keyboard keys.
* Save new training mode and replay settings to Savedata.dat.

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
* Possible fix for a crash that occurs when the codecs incorrectly identify the opening movie.
* Fixed a possible crash when training dummy guard is set to "random".
* Fixed a desync caused by I-No's Megalomania.
* Fixed P2 dummy not guarding during memory playback for P1 (a pre-existing bug).
* Fixed a crash when creating/entering a player room with Korean translation.

notes.title: March 19 2021 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Guilty Gear XX Accent Core Plus R players, we have recently pushed a new update to the release version of the game. These changes were already available in the public test branch, now you don’t need to switch to that branch anymore.

The summarized update log is as follows:
[u][h1]Features[/h1][/u]
[u][h2]New (extensive) training dummy options[/h2][/u]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8829983/7e2dd06b28aec7a286ba0014207a362fcba4165f.png[/img]
[h3]Multiple recording slots[/h3]
[list]
[*]Which slot is played can be selected on the pause screen in training mode. 4 slots are available, with the additional playback options of "random" (any filled recording slot), or "rotate" (stepping through the filled recording slots in order)
[*]Added an ability to clear previously recorded memory slot: press select during recording. Slot will be considered empty and will not be used in random/rotate playback.
[/list]
[h3]New "Playback mode" item controls exactly how the dummy executes the recording[/h3]
[list]
[*]The "normal" option functioned as previous
[*]The "autoflip" option corrects for side-switching
[*]The "instant" option skips any idle, walking, and crouching at the beginning of the replay, and executes the first attack, jump, or dash option immediately- including special moves!
[/list]
[h3]New "Stun Resist" item[/h3]
When turned on, gives you control over whether or not, or how easy, the training dummy is to stun
[h3]New "Stun Reset" item[/h3]
When turned on, resets the training dummy's stun value when they exit hitstun
[h3]New State options: "Low attack", and "Memory"[/h3]
[list]
[*]The "low attack" option causes the training dummy to periodically perform a character-specific low attack
[*]The "memory" option causes the training dummy to periodically perform the currently selected recording. If the currently selected recording is random, it plays back a random recording.
[/list]
[h3]State Repeat[/h3]
"State repeat" allows you to control how often the dummy repeats its various actions
[h3]Reversal Action[/h3]
"Reversal action" allows you to set up several reversal training mode settings:
[list]
[*]The "Attack", "Jump", "Dash Back", "Dash Forward", and "Throw" options cause the dummy to immediately perform the respective actions when exiting hitstun or blockstun.
[*]The "memory" option causes the training dummy to play back the currently selected recording. If the currently selected recording is random, it plays back a random recording.
[*]The "random" option selects from all of the above
[/list]
[h3]Reversal Type[/h3]
New option: Reversal Type. Values: All / Guard / Hit / Wakeup.
[h3]Other new options:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New Guard option: "Random"
[*]New "Guard Balance Reset" option, when turned on, immediately resets the dummy's guard balance to 0 after they exit blockstun
[*]New "Auto Psych Burst" option, when turned on, causes the dummy to burst (if it has the meter to do so) on guard, on hit, or randomly
[*]New "Burst Delay" option affects how long the dummy will wait after blocking or hitting before bursting
[*]New "Dead Angle" option, when turned on, causes the dummy to perform a dead angle (if it has the meter to do so) either on guard or randomly
[/list]
[u][h2]New replay features:[/h2][/u]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8829983/5eafd65b067cd50ee507883ddb65d253ba3afdb3.png[/img][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8829983/d7e78d40b00c48dfa0664a252d4949cdf5500c79.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Input display
[*]Option to hide P1/P2/Both usernames
[*]Rewind support
[*]Pause support, with frame by frame view
[*]Take Control option: ability to take over as P1/P2 at any point in the replay
[/list]
[u][h2]New option added to Controller Settings, Input: Original/Lenient[/h2][/u]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8829983/f4e22334c80eb4d66b9b94d29476136a35ece4b1.png[/img]
When using Lenient Input, keyboard and hitbox players will notice an improvement, as fast inputs (<1f) are no longer ignored. Only half-circles are affected by this change. This setting is applied online too!
[u][h2]Other new features[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*]Users can now press Y before entering network mode to run the performance test on their system. The game must perform well on P1 and P2 side for a good netplay experience. If you see a lot of teleporting despite stable ping and low jitter, please run the performance test to make sure the game is performing well on your end.
[*]Performance test results are now a simpler score breakdown
[*]Performance test now offers performance recommendations for systems that don't pass the test
[*]Borderless display mode added, enables users to have better system support for alt-tabbing
[*]Added new credits "GGPO UPDATE" to the Staff Roll Gallery
[/list]
[u][h1]Bugfixes:[/h1][/u]
[list]
[*]Fix a desync created by the "afterimage" effect used by high jumps (and other attacks such as Potemkin's Judge Gauntlet)
[*]Fix a possible crash when the game is closed
[*]Fix a possible crash on Windows 7 and up when Windows displays a request for admin permissions while GGXXACPR is running full-screen
[*]Fix a possible crash when network errors have resulted in a disconnect from the opponent (instead of crashing, the game now cleanly reports the disconnection).
[*]Fix a possible crash when updating Steam rich presence after returning to a player room
[*]Fixed a crash when the game is closed during dcode download/upload
[*]Fixed a crash when a character is hit on the first frame of training mode
[*]Fixed a couple of crashes related to desync detector messaging
[*]Fixed transparent training mode menu after pressing accept+cancel
[*]Fixed crash for spectator when battlers disconnect at the beginning of match
[*]Fixed crash at startup, if the opening movie was modified or if the OS doesn't provide needed codecs.
[/list]
[u][h1]Optimizations:[/h1][/u]
[list]
[*]Tweak rift correction algorithm to be more precise, reducing rollbacks
[*]On devices with both integrated and discrete graphics, such as laptops using nVidia's Optimus or similar software, GGXXACPR now requests use of dedicated graphics if the power management enables application-level selection
[*]Desync detection now uses less memory
[/list]
[u][h1]Tweaks:[/h1][/u]
[list]
[*]Window focus is now managed in a more intuitive fashion when clicking on the GGXXACPR executable's icon in the start bar, when running Windows 10
[*]Some untranslated strings translated
[*]When playing windowed, GGXXACPR is now aware of desktop DPI settings, fixing window size and blurry picture on displays not set to 100% DPI on Windows 7 and up
[*]Entering training mode in a player room now properly gives control to the controller used to enter network mode, instead of only giving control of training mode to the controller bound to player 1
[*]When browsing the list of replays, the list now wraps around when up (or down) is pressed at the top (or bottom) of the list, respectively
[*]-norecording launch argument disables replays recording
[*]Dragging the game's window no longer freezes the game's process
[*]The training mode menu now allows switching between player/enemy options using left/right when the cursor is on [i]any[/i] option without left/right choice, such as controller settings, instead of just "resume game"
[/list]

notes.title: GGPO Update officially implemented!!
notes.notes:
The much awaited GGPO has now been fully implemented to the release version of the game! Players do not need to switch to the Public Testing beta option any more.

The summarized update log is as follows:

[h1]Added GGPO:[/h1]
* Network mode now uses GGPO for online play!
* GGPO input delay can be set between 0 and 4 frames before battle by pressing left/right in a player room. A recommended delay depending on ping is displayed to the user
(0-100ms: 0f, 101-180ms: 1f, >180ms: 2f). This setting is saved.
* During a network game, ping and jitter information are displayed in the upper-right corner.

[h1]Added player rooms:[/h1]
* Network mode now supports player rooms of up to six players!
* Anyone not playing will spectate the current match.

[h1]Added replay support:[/h1]
* A replay gallery is now accessible from the main menu! Single and team, offline and online games replays are automatically recorded after each match.
* Replays are saved in %USERPROFILE%\Documents\ARC SYSTEM WORKS\GGXXAC\Replays\, and can be shared with other users.

[h1]New Training Mode features:[/h1]
* [LEFT or RIGHT]+RESET: Reset to left/right corner.
* DOWN+RESET: Reset with player sides switched; can be combined with left or right.

[h2]Many more minor bug fixes, Quality of Life improvements and tweaks.[/h2]

On a side note, public testing is still on going with a tester-version with log tracking and other tools at the public testing beta.

notes.title: Bug Fixes #03 - 06/03
notes.notes:
- Added a "V-Sync On/Off" toggle function in Options. For players experiencing input delays (please do not confuse with network delay), kindly switch this option "OFF". The default is "ON".
- Added a function to allow users to log out and return to the mortal realm. Apologies for the inconvenience caused.
- Reduced the SE volume during continuous Faultless Defense blocking.
- Added "RESET" and "PAUSE MENU" (aka Start/Back) to Controller Settings.
- Added display of 1P or 2P at Pause menu, depending on which player pressed the pause button.

*****
- Tweaked online performance. 
For better online experience, please kindly set "Connection Quality" as "ON" for your online search parameters.

- Added 4:3 support
Without side panels, as by popular demand.
